R6F-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6F-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Trail: Alexander Mackenzie Trail, 4.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
7 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 177 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.95585, -125.50474, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk 510 m to the start. Walk: the Alexander Mackenzie Trail stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 97 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-1, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
